Written by tools/review-triage-calibration/derive-pilot.mjs from the owner's 54-row session:
the 24 calibration rows drawn from OUTSIDE the 220-row sample, plus the 13 DEV overlap rows
inside it. The 17 HOLDOUT overlap rows are not here and must never be — section 6.2 reads the
holdout once, and a pilot is not what it was saved for.
This is NOT gold. It is a screen (section 10.4): 37 rows can rule a candidate out and cannot
rule one in. No Wilson lower bound computed on it can reach section 5's 0.80 precision gate
even on a perfect run, so a pilot number quoted as if it had cleared that gate misreads both
files. Same closed vocabularies, same absence of everything else, as labels.json.
